brief:
A writing workshop titled "Tomorrow's Women" aims to strengthen confidence among female participants in Gaza, We Are Not Numbers reported. The initiative uses creative writing as a tool for personal development and self-expression in the territory.

Details about the workshop's duration, location, and specific outcomes were not immediately available. The program reflects efforts by civil society groups to support youth development amid Gaza's challenging conditions.
dek: Building women's confidence through a writing workshop in Gaza…
title: Writing workshop builds confidence among Gaza's young women
